Selected the 3 blocks matching categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField === "lowerBound" AND keyRange === undefined (the melee/ranged blocks are SUBSETS of dps and would double-count 27 specs): 27 + 7 + 6 = 40 rows, 0 roster misses, classSpec names byte-identical to the roster. Re-merged at the source's own snapshotDate, rounded to the stored 1-decimal convention; all 40 lowerBound values are byte-identical to the committed data, so nothing moved. PARTIAL rather than success because the source's own date lags the run by 2 days and asOf must be wowmeta's snapshotDate, never today — the real staleness alarm is the contract's maxAgeDays of 8, which this does not breach.

All 27 DPS specs requested fresh this run at talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 attempts each and a pause between calls. 24 charts returned real payloads; 3 specs (Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker) returned the 76-byte {"status":"error"} body on all 3 attempts, which after retry is read as upstream not having re-simmed them rather than as an outage — the other 24 succeeded interleaved in the same minutes. simc_settings.ptr compared EXPLICITLY against the string "0" (it is truthy in JS), and `tier` was READ off each chart rather than assumed: all 24 report MID2, matching the stored pool, so the uniformity gate holds and no mixed-tier merge was possible. asOf taken per spec from each chart's own timestamp, never the run date: 23 charts at 2026-09-09 and 1 at 2026-09-10. FERAL DRUID IS BACK — it was one of the four dropped in the 2026-09-03 wholesale MID2 adoption and re-simmed upstream today, so it joins the pool on its own night exactly as the adoption note anticipated; the pool goes 23 -> 24, a row ADD, so neither the row floor (15) nor the 25% row-drop gate is in play, and no stored value moved. The coverage date (min-th-freshest with min 15) therefore stays 2026-09-09, one day old, because only the one new chart carries today's date.

The git hash moved from ba72a9dcfe (last night's) to ba1d6a064f, which is the honest reason all 23 stored values moved; the largest single move is 2.21%, far below the 60% value-move gate, and no human ack is needed. 45 ranking entries parsed, the Raid aggregate row skipped, mapped by LONGEST PREFIX with a hyphen allowed in the variant suffix (so MID2_Demon_Hunter_Devourer_Void-Scarred maps rather than being dropped onto a lesser build) -> best hero variant per DPS spec = 23 of 27. Four channels swept, and ONE new live 12.1 round-up landed. (1) The official revision ledger ran first, from this run's pre-agent official-notes artifact (checkedAt 2026-09-10T14:39:26Z): live-hotfixes topic 2336376 post 1 is now at version 33 (was 31), last edited 2026-09-09T23:21:51Z, with 7 UNRESOLVED sections — 6 Classes and 1 Player versus Player, all dated 2026-09-09 — and ptr-preview topic 2344395 unchanged at post 1 version 3 with all 3 sections still applied and hash-identical. All 7 obligations are now resolved in data/official-notes.json and node src/check-official-notes.mjs passes. (2) The canonical Discourse body was read directly (topic 2336376.json, 266,024 bytes, title now "World of Warcraft: Midnight Hotfixes - September 9", post 1 version 33 — matching the receipt exactly) with its <ul> heading structure INTACT, and a new kind:"hotfix" entry dated 2026-09-09 was added to data/ptr-builds.json (29 -> 30 entries) covering Blood DK, Guardian Druid, Protection Paladin, Priest (class-wide), Enhancement Shaman, Arms Warrior and Protection Warrior plus a non-class summary. The Flash Heal line sits under a BARE Priest heading, so it is logged class-wide rather than guessed onto Discipline and Shadow (2026-09-02 Warrior Bladestorm precedent); the Preservation Evoker Stasis fix is PvP-only and triages out. Both Warrior lines touch a Venomous Abyss set bonus, so Arms and Protection Warrior's spec.tierSet.asOf advanced to 2026-09-09 with the September 9 topic as source and a dated parenthetical recording that only Cooldown Manager tracking changed, and gearing/data/specs.json was re-synced (harvest-specs + --check) and the gearing artifact rebuilt in the same change. ⚠ A CLASSIFIER DEFECT IS DISCLOSED RATHER THAN WORKED AROUND: both Warrior highlights classify as a NERF under classifyHighlight because the clause carries the noun "damage buff" beside the words "Cooldown Manager" (matching RESOURCE_TERM's `cooldown`), inverting a UI-tracking line into a resource nerf. The verbatim blue-post text is stored anyway — rewording a highlight to steer the tally would be gaming it — and the misfire cannot move either arrow, since both Warriors carry a dated ptr.verdict of Mixed that outranks the tally; it only writes a -1 into their basis line. Flagged for an owner-side fix. (3) Wowhead news RSS (40 items, HTTP 200, 204,557 bytes, parsed per <item> block) carried the mirror at news=382794 (2026-09-09T23:47), whose body matches the canonical post line for line; the news INDEX (data.news.newsData, brace-balanced from the id attribute) leads no further, topping out at the same 382794. (4) The blue-tracker index (data.blueTracker.default, 50 entries deduped by topic) shows no standalone class-tuning blue post since "Class Tuning Incoming - September 1" (2026-08-31), which is already carried by the 2026-08-28 build entry. The 12.1.5 lane stayed NOTES ONLY: PHASES.ptr is untouched at null, nothing 12.1.5 entered ptr-builds or any ptr verdict, and no archived 12.1 PTR metric was relabelled. The dormant WCL PTR zone sweeps (52/54/56/57) were correctly skipped — their contract rows were removed at the flip. Nightly mode, so the keyword filter stays on: 156 title hits, 10 of them PvP-framed and triaged out, leaving 146 candidates. Curation was deliberately narrow: the video's own thesis is that the overall raid DPS ranking is a logging artifact of the early bosses, so the caster cluster at the top was NOT distilled as spec strength, and Arms Warrior and Frost Mage — the only two DPS reads that survive — are recorded MIXED rather than positive because he is explicit that Twin Fangs is the only boss in the tier with that two-target profile. The buffs enumerated for Balance Druid, Beast Mastery, Frost DK and Survival were dropped under the list-mention rule (bare enumeration, no spec-specific read), as was Mistweaver Monk, which appears only inside his recital of the pre-tier consensus. TJe8OnXl3pY was removed from videos[] in the same edit so no id sits in two lanes. The remaining candidates are gameplay VODs, key runs, boss/spec guides and 12.1.5 feature explainers, which the distillation rules say carry no spec-strength read; they were left UNSEEN rather than marked seen, so the next run reconsiders them.
